label: fs-w146-native-width1024-phase-r1
purpose: Complete native width1024 model phase after exact width1152 ownership gate. Same host/source146, seed42, T1024/pack32/GA1, all current NKI/ownership/exact-CE options. Compare D1024 control then D1152 capacity candidate; only width and its required derived shape/group costs differ. All four numerical postchecks and pre/post cleanup remain. This estimates the time/capacity tradeoff before one bounded quality trial, not an equal-parameter kernel speed or BPB claim.
command:
import pathlib,json,subprocess,re
r=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave146')
gate='fs-w146-width1152-optimizer-ownership-gate-r1'
post=json.loads((r/('research/run-logs/'+gate+'.postflight.json')).read_text())
assert post['host_clean'] and post['command_returncode']==0
raw=(r/('research/run-logs/'+gate+'.log')).read_text()
checks=[json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw[m.end():])[0] for m in re.finditer('OPTIMIZER_OWNERSHIP_EQUIVALENCE ',raw)]
tags={'iteration1','iteration2','iteration3','iteration4','continued','restored','after_timing'}
assert len(checks)==28 and {(d['rank'],d['tag']) for d in checks}=={(rank,tag) for rank in range(4) for tag in tags}
assert all(d['exact_reference'] and d['all_rank_weight_bytes_exact'] and d['failure_count']==0 for d in checks)
subprocess.run(['/home/ubuntu/workspace/native_venv/bin/torchrun', '--standalone', '--nproc_per_node=4', '/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave146/research/scratch/phase_timer.py', '--steps', '30', '--warmup-steps', '5', '--seed', '42', '--foreach-optim', '--pack-factor', '32', '--no-ngram-ve', '--dataloader', 'real', '--set', 'DEPTH=6', '--set', 'N_EMBD=1024', '--set', 'USE_QK_SHIFT=False', '--set', 'QK_SHIFT_BETA=0.0', '--set', 'QK_SHIFT_FREEZE=True', '--set', 'USE_COMPILE_MUON=True', '--set', 'USE_NKI_MUON=False', '--set', 'COMPILE_SDPA_DIRECT=True', '--post-checks', '--set', 'USE_NKI_LOCAL_CONV=True', '--set', 'USE_BF16_NORM_OUTPUT=True', '--fused-mlp', '--fused-mlp-weight-mode', '0', '--fused-mlp-forward-backend', 'native', '--optimizer-ownership', '--optimizer-ownership-pad-singletons', '--set', 'SEQ_LEN=1024', '--adaptive-nki-ce'],check=True)
